subtasks: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.
Keep holding the pen holder with the right hand. With the left hand, place the remaining purple highlighter from the table into the holder, flat barrel tail down and capped end up.
Hold the pen holder with the right hand. With the left hand, place the two remaining black pens into the holder one at a time, each with its small exposed writing tip pointing down.
Set the filled pen holder upright on the table with the right hand, release it, fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses without disturbing the four pens.
